pressure.title: Health status at a glance: OK – warning – alarm
pressure.description: Permanently installed sensors send vibration, temperature and oil-condition data at intervals (seconds to hours) through a gateway to a historian and analytics. Trends against baselines and alarm limits flag developing faults weeks ahead (P–F interval), so repairs are planned instead of reacting to breakdowns. Here the fan is healthy (green), the pump shows a rising trend (amber), and the gearbox oil sensor reports wear debris (red). Wireless sensors trade data rate / battery life against detail; critical machines still use wired protection systems (API 670).

video_tutorials.title: Online Condition Monitoring System — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Online Condition Monitoring System.

An online condition monitoring system gathers vibration, temperature and oil-condition data from many machines continuously through wired or wireless sensors and a gateway into a historian and analytics, which compare trends with baselines and alarm limits so developing faults are found early and repairs can be planned.
Typical applications include plant-wide monitoring of balance-of-plant machines; remote sites and hazardous areas where routes are hard.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Fan Impeller, Process Pump & Motor, Process Pump & Motor — Shaft & Coupling (turning).
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

script.narration: How the Online Condition Monitoring System works.
Sensors measure on each machine.
Data travels to the gateway.
Server analyses trends.
Dashboard shows health and alerts.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.
Permanently installed sensors send vibration, temperature and oil-condition data at intervals (seconds to hours) through a gateway to a historian and analytics.

video_tutorials.title: Online Condition Monitoring System — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Online Condition Monitoring System.
Review dashboard alerts.
Check battery and network health.
Replace sensors / batteries; update models.
Watch for missed fault: failure without alert. Common cause: wrong sensor location, poor limits.
Watch for data gaps: missing trends. Common cause: network / battery.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
